guide.instagram: Connect the account you post to there. It has to be a professional account, which Instagram requires to be public.
guide.key: Create an API key limited to one profile, and paste it here. A read-only key is enough to see your posts, and it cannot schedule.

key.label: {{provider}} API key
key.invalid: That does not look like a key.
key.readOnly: This key is read-only, so your posts show but nothing can be scheduled. To schedule, replace it with a read and write key.
key.expired: Your key has expired. What you planned and scheduled is safe. Add a key to carry on.
key.revoke: Forgetting a key removes it from this browser. To cancel it everywhere, use your <site>{{provider}} dashboard</site>.

account.label: Account
account.none: This key has no connected account yet.
account.reconnect: This account needs connecting again before anything can be scheduled.

post.title: Schedule a post

status.failed: This did not go out. Pick a new time to try again, or cancel it.

post.description_one: This image goes out at the time you choose.
post.description_other: These {{count}} images go out as a carousel at the time you choose.
post.caption: Caption
post.timeInvalid: Pick a time at least {{minutes}} minutes from now.
post.outOfOrder: With this time, posts will not go out in the order of your grid.
post.notice: When you schedule, the images and caption are sent to {{provider}} and Instagram. When it is published, one anonymous note of its kind, size and delay is sent to Lineup. Nothing else leaves this device.
post.noKey: Add your key in Settings to schedule this.
post.readOnly: This key is read-only. Replace it in Settings with a read and write key to schedule this.
post.noAccount: Connect an Instagram account in Settings to schedule this. Instagram only allows it for a professional account.
post.cancelDescription: It will not go out, and is removed from {{provider}}. The image goes back to being a planned cell.

live.failed: A post did not go out.

post.freePublished: Freeing this cell leaves the post on Instagram, and it shows after the planned cells.
post.freeWithoutKey: Without a key that can post, this can't be changed from here. Freeing the cell does not stop the post: it stays at {{provider}}.
post.missingCopy: This image's full copy is no longer on this device, so it cannot be sent.

videoLimit.size: Instagram takes a video of up to {{size}} MB.
videoLimit.length: Instagram takes a Reel of up to {{minutes}} minutes.
videoLimit.count_one: A carousel can hold one video.

tags.title: Tag accounts
tags.hint: Tap the picture where you want a tag, type the username and press Enter. Drag a tag to move it, or use the arrow keys (hold Shift for bigger steps). Up to {{limit}} per post.
tags.videoHint: Add the accounts to tag in this video. Up to {{limit}} per post.
tags.marker: {{name}}, {{x}} from the left, {{y}} from the top. Move with the arrow keys, remove with Delete.
tags.full: That is the most Instagram allows on a post, {{limit}} tags.
tags.place: Place a tag on the picture. Then type the username.
tags.tapPicture: Tap the picture to add a tag.

spacing.before: The post at position {{position}} on your grid needs about {{minutes}} minutes to go live before this one.
spacing.after: This post needs about {{minutes}} minutes to go live before the post at position {{position}} on your grid.
spacing.video: A post with a video can take several minutes to go live, and Instagram orders posts by when they go live.
spacing.image: Instagram can take a few minutes to publish a post, and orders posts by when they go live.
spacing.noRoom: There is no time between these posts that leaves enough room. You can still schedule it.
spacing.legend: Marked times are too near a post already scheduled: {{image}} minutes for pictures, {{video}} for a video, and more for a large one.

alt.title: Accessibility
alt.hint: Describe each picture for people who use a screen reader.

strip.label: Reorder the slides
strip.instructions: Press Space to pick up a slide, move it with the arrow keys, and press Space to drop it. Press Enter to show it.

collaborators.title: Collaborators
collaborators.label: Invite a collaborator
collaborators.hint: Up to {{limit}} Instagram accounts. They get an invite, and the post is shared once they accept.
collaborators.full: That is the most Instagram allows, {{limit}} collaborators. Remove one to add another.

facts.commentsOff: Comments are turned off, if Instagram allows it.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.commentsNote: Turning off comments is best effort. It is applied just after the post is published, and if that fails the post stays live with comments on.
advanced.firstCommentHint: Posted as a comment on your post just after it is published.

published.failed: Could not load your published posts.

problems.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
problems.not_found: That could not be found. It may have been removed.
problems.validation: Something in this was not valid. Check it and try again.
problems.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
problems.origin: This request was blocked. Reload the page and try again.
problems.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
problems.key_missing: Your key has gone. Add it again in Settings.
problems.key_rejected: That key was refused. Check it and try again.
problems.key_not_allowed: This key is not allowed to do that.
problems.profile_required: Choose a profile for this key.
problems.idempotency_required: This request was missing something. Reload the page and try again.
problems.time_in_past: Pick a time at least {{minutes}} minutes from now.
problems.provider_busy: This is still being worked on. Try again in a moment.
problems.provider_failed: The scheduling service did not answer. Try again in a moment.

swapped.title: Some posts went live in a different order
swapped.description: Instagram orders your posts by when they actually went live, not by the time you scheduled, so these two swapped places on your profile.
swapped.tip: Leaving more time between posts, especially posts with a video, avoids this.
swapped.picture: A post that went live out of order
